detail_en: Source-specific method/path and event identities remain distinct where testable. Repeated generic validation, durable-boundary context, and acceptance evidence still require a separate semantic duplicate audit; no item-level removal is justified by string similarity alone.

Individual fields or constraints are independently testable only with their inherited entity, endpoint, direction, and column context; a short quoted value is not a global requirement.
The three quotes occur in the page 8 embedded illustration, not the PDF text layer. Render inspection confirms all three literal control assertions.
